verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a publicly reachable OpenAPI 3.1 spec for jo's backend and an llms.txt file, but no official SDK in any language. The probe also notes that no developer program or public API keys are documented. A raw API spec is at most a building block from which a developer could generate a client; it is not an official SDK, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
